title: Introduce idle-heartbeat-stitcher and soft-evict protector (hotfix)
author: Priya Kaur
description: Motivation: during a recent surge in ephemeral tenant load we observed premature eviction of connections and aggressive KV cache drops in the regional slowpath which caused cascading latency spikes and a larger-than-expected SLO breach. Root cause analysis showed short-lived heartbeat jitter + transient control-plane lag incorrectly flagged connections as idle. This PR introduces two cooperating mitigations behind a feature flag: (1) idle-heartbeat-stitcher: emits/forwards short synthetic heartbeat pings for connections that are edge-idle but have recent inflight KV usage; the stitcher is conservative (probabilistic sampling + exponential backoff) to avoid increasing overall load; (2) soft-evict protector: an eviction gating layer that applies a temporal occupancy window and telemetry-aware hysteresis to prevent mass-evictions when node-level KV pressure or probe latency briefly spikes. Changes: - serving/kv_cache.go: protects kv metadata with a small lock-free fastpath and exposes last-active timestamps used by the stitcher - scheduler/evictor.go: new SoftEvictProtector that defers evictions for a short grace window when metrics indicate transient pressure - controlplane/flags.go: feature flag + rollout gating + canary percentage - telemetry/metrics.go: new metrics (evict_protector_decisions, heartbeat_stitched_count, stitcher_sample_rate) and labels for region/cohort - tests/evictor_test.go + integration/evictor_integration_test.go: simulate jittered heartbeats and transient probe delays - charts/helm/redwood-evictor-values.yaml: defaults for feature flag and canary rollout Rolling plan: feature-flag off by default; enable for 1% of production in us-west-2 for a 30-minute canary with enhanced tracing. If canary looks stable, scale to 10% then 50% and full rollout. Observability: dashboards added to watch the new metrics and KV retention percentiles. Backout plan: feature-flag off; immediate eviction policy rollback script included. This description intentionally compresses design rationale and rollout steps into a single narrative for the PR body.

review_thread: Marco Diaz: Can you explain why we chose probabilistic stitching vs always-forwarding a heartbeat? Concern: potential extra load on already constrained nodes.

Priya Kaur (author): We sample so only a tiny fraction (configurable default 0.5%) get synthetic heartbeats; we biased sampling toward flows that show KV touch in the last 5s to target only hot-but-idle connections. I added a note in the code and a metric stitcher_sample_rate so SRE can tune live.
Evelyn Chen: There's a subtle race where last-active may be updated concurrently while stitcher is reading; please ensure lock-free fastpath can't observe partial state.

Priya Kaur: Fixed: added an atomic load of lastActive and added a small critical section around the KV meta update in the latest commit g7b9d1f. Also added evictor unit test to reproduce the race and guard it.

Samir Patel: Integration test failed on first CI run — eviction deferred longer than expected in one scenario, causing memory pressure in a stress test. Can we bound total deferred items per node and add a circuit to force-evict if buffers grow too large?
Priya Kaur: Added bounded queue with hard cap and a fallback forced-evict when cap is exceeded; metrics will emit forced_evict_count. Re-ran integration locally before pushing fix.
Marco Diaz: Approve after the forced-evict cap and a clear rollout plan are included.
Evelyn Chen: LGTM — please coordinate with SRE for canary window and set up dashboard alerts for stitcher_sample_rate and forced_evict_count.
Merge note: Squash-merged by CI bot once all checks passed and approvals met.

release_notes: Hotfix: prevent mass premature evictions caused by heartbeat jitter and control-plane lag. Adds idle-heartbeat-stitcher (probabilistic synthetic heartbeats) and soft-evict protector (telemetry-aware eviction gating). Feature behind feature flag; default off. Observability metrics added: evict_protector_decisions, heartbeat_stitched_count, forced_evict_count.
notes_for_ops: During canary enablement watch: - stitcher_sample_rate (should match configured percentage) - evict_protector_decisions{region} - forced_evict_count (should be zero) - node_kv_retention_percentile p50/p90. If forced_evict_count > 0 or memory climbs > 5% above baseline, revert flag immediately.
